html: Low back pain is very common. It often follows a strain from lifting, twisting or long periods of sitting, and usually improves within a few weeks.

• Stay gently active rather than resting in bed
  • Apply heat or cold for comfort
  • Pay attention to posture when sitting and lifting
Get care promptly if back pain follows a fall or injury, comes with numbness or weakness in the legs, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel control.

title: Low back pain
abstract: An overview of everyday low back pain and steps that often help.
